name: phoenix-tekton-editor
description: phoenix-Tekton — Service Blueprint Studio (browser-mode editor; Tauri shell lands with the desktop pass)

scripts.wasm: cargo build -p blueprint-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen ~/.cache/cargo-target/phoenix-Tekton/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/blueprint_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir src/engine
scripts.desktop:win: tauri build --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --config '{"bundle":{"active":false}}' && bash scripts/verify-windows-exe.sh
